title: refactor(metadata-protocol): the two overlay-write closes ask one fix-can-be-taken predicate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ897VUcPShHgSHgmfYBAj4Gx)_
Fixes #29397

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个覆盖层写入关闭判定(`namedBaseCloseSubject`、`packagelessCloseSubject`)里逐步重复的「修复能否走通」四步(配对 id、ensure 门、基包版本、D2 门放行声明体)收成一个共享判定 `overlayPairFixOf` + `overlayPairFixAdmits`,各自只保留本该不同的那部分。
- 为什么改:两份副本逐步相同,改其中一份时另一份会悄悄漂移;合同评审 S6 要求合并。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,拒绝文案、状态码、调用顺序都不变,两个关闭的既有测试原样通过;回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`(新判定与具名关闭)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`(无包关闭,行读取仍夹在两半之间)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`(补的三条控制用例)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`,预期 31/31 全绿,含三条新的「某一步失败则写入保持开放」控制用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## Why

The contract review of #29270 (record 6577747588, should-fix S6) found that the two overlay-write closes judge "can the fix the refusal names be taken" with the same four steps, written twice. A change to one copy could drift from the other with every pin still green. This PR keeps one copy.

## What changes

- **One predicate, two halves** (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, the module that owns the override write gate and both refusal sentences):
  - `overlayPairFixOf(host, base)`: the registry half. The base has a pair id, the ensure door would answer or create the pair (`customizationPairEnsureRefusal`), and the base records a `manifest.version`. It answers `{ base, pair, basedOn }` or `null`.
  - `overlayPairFixAdmits(host, fix, { type, name, body, member })`: the gate half. The override write gate admits the declared body (`overrides: { package: base, basedOn }`) into the pair.
  - It has two halves because the package-less close reads the item's stored rows between them, and only for a name the registry has not already left open. Folding the row read in front would change the call order and which failure wins (a store-read failure before a registry `null`).
- **`namedBaseCloseSubject`** keeps only its own steps: a named package, a body carrying `overrides` stays the D2 gate's, the named package among the shippers, and the declared body from the save (no row read).
- **`packagelessCloseSubject`** keeps only its own steps: exactly one shipper, the item's row read, and `classifyPackagelessRow`.
- **Unchanged:** `closedOverlayWriteClauses`, both refusal sentences, `protocol.ts` (no line touched; its two host methods and their eight call sites are as on `main`), and the return shape `{ base, pair }`. The new functions are internal: `src/index.ts` names its exports, and neither is added there.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch (see Acceptance notes for why it is not `skip-changeset`).

### Measured first, on `main` at 42ff86f6

Every step of the two predicates, common or intended-different (line numbers are `main`'s):

| Step | `namedBaseCloseSubject` (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`) | `packagelessCloseSubject` (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`) | Verdict |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Which write | `:394-395` a non-empty package | `:729` no package | intended-different |
| `overrides` in the body | `:399` left to the D2 gate | (classified at `:764`, `foreign_declaration`) | intended-different (both docblocks say so) |
| Shippers | `:400` the named one among them | `:731-733` exactly one | intended-different (the card) |
| Pair id | `:401-403` | `:734-736` | common |
| Registry present | `:404-405` | `:737-738` | common |
| Ensure door | `:406` | `:739` | common |
| Base version | `:407-408` reads `registry.getPackage(base)` | `:740-741` `baseVersionOf` re-reads `engine.registry` | common. Same value: `ObjectQL#registry` is a getter over one never-reassigned field, and `getPackage` was already proved a function at the step above |
| Row read and classification | none | `:743-768` | intended-different (the card) |
| Member of the declared body | `:411-415` keyed on `isPlainRecord(item)` | `:754-756` keyed on `item !== undefined` | spelled differently, same answer for every JSON body: for a non-record body both read the canonical member. Left in each close, not folded, so the fold stays move-only |
| Declared body and gate | `:416-423` | `:770-778` | common |

No step differs by accident, so the card's stop condition did not fire.

## Tests

- **No existing pin was edited.** `protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts` gained fixtures (three packages and two shipped dashboards that no existing case addresses) and one new top-level `describe`. The package-less close's pins (`packages/objectql/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts`, `environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`, `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`) were not touched.
- **Step coverage before this PR:**

  | Step | named close | package-less close |
  |:---|:---|:---|
  | pair id | none | `no_pair` case |
  | ensure door | `a read-only base whose pair cannot be ensured` | `an unensurable pair` cases |
  | base version | none | none |
  | gate refuses the declared body | none | the `email_template` unshipped-locale reset |

- **Three new pins, all through the named close, all green on `main` before the fold** (commit 0dc436c3 on 42ff86f6), and each shown able to fail: a write naming a read-only base whose id forms no pair, a base that records no version while its pair is installed, and an `email_template` at a locale the base does not ship. Each stays open, as on `main`. One `basedOn` pin covers both closes now, because the step lives once.

## Acceptance notes

- **The version step is not separately observable today.** Delete only the `basedOn` check and the no-version pin stays green: the gate then sees `overrides` with no `basedOn`, which `OverrideDeclarationSchema` rejects, so the gate judges the body as an undeclared same name in the pair and refuses it. The pin still pins the outcome: a fallback version (`?? '0.0.0'`) reds it (Verification, ablation 4). The check is kept as it was.
- **Changeset, not `skip-changeset`.** No published behaviour changes, but the shipped `dist/` of `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` does (the build carries the new functions). AGENTS.md keeps `skip-changeset` for a diff that publishes nothing, so this is a `patch`. The order allowed `skip-changeset` if no behaviour changed; AGENTS.md wins.
- The predicate guard `registry present with a getPackage function` is a type guard reached only by an engine without a registry. It is not one of the card's four steps and is not pinned. That is unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Unit tests at ba4aaf11 (the head, main merged in at 3a856f68, after #29797's 5f99582e): @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck and full suite, and the package-less close's three objectql files against the rebuilt dist</summary>

```
pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol...' build
  VERDICT command-exit 0           (dist/index.js carries overlayPairFixOf)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  31 passed (31)      (25 of this PR, with #29797's six; the three new controls among them)
  VERDICT command-exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test
  Test Files  311 passed | 4 skipped (315)
       Tests  22320 passed | 26 skipped (22346)
  VERDICT command-exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.test.ts src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts
  Test Files  3 passed (3)
       Tests  105 passed (105)
  VERDICT command-exit 0
```

Earlier heads: at e1c8a104 the suite read 22314/22314 and the objectql files 105/105; at 408cc35c, 22308/22308 and 105/105.
</details>

<details><summary>New pins on main first: 25/25 at 0dc436c3 (the pins on 42ff86f6, before the fold)</summary>

```
✓ CONTROLS: every step the fix takes, failing, leaves the write naming the base open (ADR-0146 D1, D11) > a read-only base whose id forms no pair (an id ending in `.custom`) keeps the write naming it: there is no pair to name
✓ … > a read-only base that records no version, its pair installed, keeps the write naming it: there is no `basedOn` to declare
✓ … > an email template at a locale the base does not ship keeps the write naming the base: the override write gate refuses its declared body
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  25 passed (25)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation on main: four mutations of namedBaseCloseSubject through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each landed on disk and was restored to the HEAD blob</summary>

The file was `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`. The blob was 410bf525 before, and it was 410bf525 after every restore, equal to HEAD.

1. `if (!pairId.ok) return null;` replaced with a no-op: the no-pair-id pin goes red, 1 failed | 24 passed.
2. The `basedOn` check deleted: 25 passed. The step is masked by the gate (see Acceptance notes).
3. The gate's `refuse` return deleted: the unshipped-locale pin goes red, 1 failed | 24 passed.
4. `basedOn` given the fallback `?? '0.0.0'`: the no-version pin goes red, 1 failed | 24 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates at e1c8a104: 59 derived, 58 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED; pnpm lint exit 0. Re-run at ba4aaf11: the ratchet and text families, all exit 0</summary>

At ba4aaf11 (the merge brings no change to this PR's four files; `git diff --stat origin/main HEAD` still reads 4 files, +177 / -53), a declared narrowing to the ratchet and text families: `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, and eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the three changed source files: every one exit 0. CI runs the full set on this head.

The full union, at e1c8a104:

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (change set: the four files above, vs merge base on `origin/main`), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then `--ran`:

```
Run reconciliation — 59 derived, 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  NOT-MEASURED · DERIVED (1):
    - node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test   [exit 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET]
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED
pnpm lint :: exit 0
```

NOT MEASURED, reason: that self-test's fixture is pinned to a commit outside this shallow clone (it asks for `git fetch --unshallow`). CI runs it on a full checkout. Every other derived family exited 0, including `check:durability-log-level`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt`.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
